title: Cost-Effectiveness, Budget Impact, and HTA Record
purpose: Summarize cost-effectiveness, affordability, distribution, HTA, reimbursement, adoption conditions, uncertainty, and recommendation.
notes: Synthetic example. Replace all values with authorized local evidence before institutional use.

records.Guidance: Report disaggregated and summary results relative to the comparator.
records.Institutional response: Synthetic base case: +€180,000 over three years and 8.2 serious events avoided.

records.Guidance: State the threshold, currency and price year, and probability that the preferred option is cost-effective.
records.Institutional response: Synthetic result: positive net benefit at the stated threshold; 72% probability of cost-effectiveness.

records.Guidance: Report eligible volume, uptake, implementation timing, annual cash flow, funding source, and cashable versus non-cashable savings.
records.Institutional response: Year 1 €145,000 net cost; Year 2 €35,000; Year 3 €5,000 saving; no headcount reduction assumed.

records.Guidance: Report subgroup outcomes, access, burdens, opportunity costs, mitigation, and residual concern.
records.Institutional response: Lower benefit with incomplete language data; mitigation includes interpreter-supported workflow and subgroup monitoring.

records.Guidance: Distinguish authorization, external clinical evidence, joint or national assessment, and local evidence.
records.Institutional response: Exact product and version verified; external evidence promising; local silent-mode evidence required.

records.Guidance: Identify coverage, coding, tariff, payer, claim, denial, and incentive implications.
records.Institutional response: No separate reimbursement; value arises through avoided harm and released capacity.

records.Guidance: Record readiness, procurement, workforce, quality, accreditation, governance, and monitoring prerequisites.
records.Institutional response: Interface testing, role-based training, quality-control plan, audit rights, and tested rollback.

records.Guidance: Identify parameters that may change the decision and the value, cost, and timing of further research.
records.Institutional response: Event prevalence, response effect, and review burden are decision critical; collect six months of local evidence.

records.Guidance: Record adopt, pilot, conditional use, restrict, defer, redesign, reject, or retire, together with conditions and review date.
records.Institutional response: Proceed to a time-limited silent-mode evaluation with predefined safety, workload, equity, and budget thresholds.
